journeys.name: Specify delivery address for certificate
journeys.description: Allows the user to add a delivery address and finalize the certificate delivery request.

journeys.name: Download a certificate
journeys.description: Allows users to view and download certificates in framework or standard-based formats.

journeys.name: Access a shared certificate
journeys.description: Allows external users to validate a sharing code and view as well as download shared certificates in framework or standard-based formats.

journeys.name: Search for qualifications
journeys.description: Allows the user to search for qualifications using their Unique Learner Number and confirm relevant details.

journeys.name: Provide additional qualification information
journeys.description: Enables the user to provide extra details to accurately find their qualifications.

journeys.name: View and manage certificates
journeys.description: Displays a hub for users to view and manage certificates they own.
